title: spiranthes autumnalis
intro: Spiranthes autumnalis, commonly known as the autumn lady's tresses, is a type of orchid plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues and its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Spiranthes autumnalis include its expectorant and diuretic effects, which help in relieving congestion and fluid retention. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
